title: tokenizers v1：编码、解码与扩展性能实测
summary: Hugging Face 发布 tokenizers v1 版本，这是其广泛使用的分词库的一次重大更新。文章围绕 encode（编码）、decode（解码）以及 scaling（扩展性）三个核心维度展开，并提供了实测数据。编码方面，v1 在保持 API 兼容的同时优化了底层实现，提升了吞吐量；解码方面，验证了从 token id 还原文本的正确性与效率；扩展性方面，重点测试了多线程/多进程场景下的性能表现，展示其在高并发与大规模数据处理中的能力。文章通过基准测试对比了不同配置下的速度与资源占用，说明 v1 在训练与推理流水线中可显著降低分词开销。整体而言，该版本强调生产可用性，适合需要高性能文本预处理的大模型训练与部署场景。
summary_en: Hugging Face has released tokenizers v1, a major update to its widely used tokenization library. The post focuses on three core dimensions: encode, decode, and scaling, backed by measured benchmarks. For encoding, v1 keeps API compatibility while optimizing the underlying implementation to improve throughput. For decoding, it verifies correctness and efficiency when reconstructing text from token ids. For scaling, it highlights performance under multi-threaded and multi-process workloads, demonstrating suitability for high-concurrency and large-scale data processing. The article compares speed and resource usage across configurations, showing that v1 can significantly reduce tokenization overhead in training and inference pipelines. Overall, the release emphasizes production readiness for high-performance text preprocessing in large model training and deployment.
